title: Reconstruction-independent moment tests for sample-based spectral functions — reproduction repository
description: Reproduction deposit for N. Bonilla Vargas, Reconstruction-independent moment tests for sample-based spectral functions, manuscript prepared for SciPost Physics Core (deposit 2.0.0, 2026-10-02). It contains the manuscript sources, the exact sector-Lanczos/Haydock engine and every generator behind the quoted numbers and figures, the deposited data (one dated JSON per computation), the hash-sealed pre-registrations and records of the blinded calibration and of the on-device nk test (which submitted no device job), the raw counts and submitted circuits of the IBM Quantum (ibm_fez) jobs, a smoke test with a record check (python src/verify.py), Makefile targets and a notebook that run the generators. Every moment in the work is evaluated classically; the device supplies only sampled supports. What does not regenerate exactly from source is listed in docs/REPRODUCE.md (Known gaps). Code under the MIT licence; manuscript, data and documentation under CC BY 4.0; the SciPost template files keep their own terms.
